headline: Hot October CPI (0.4% headline, 0.3% core vs 0.3%/0.2%) plus Waller floating a 50 bp December hike: NQ −1.4% at the overnight low, 10-year +7 bp to 4.94%. Lean SHORT below 27,700; flip long only on a reclaim of ~27,870.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · CPI out 8:30 AM ET (hot) · Waller spoke before the data · Veterans Day tomorrow is a bond-market holiday

flip.long: Flip LONG only if NQ reclaims and holds ~27,870 (overnight midpoint, ≈ NDX Monday close 27,908 after the ~107-pt premium). Target the Monday settle 28,014.
flip.short: SHORT stays on while NQ is below 27,700. Targets 27,500, then ~27,335 (≈ NDX Monday low 27,228).

thesis: A medium-conviction **SHORT** for the open. **NQ is −385.75 pts / −1.38% at 27,628.75 (≈8:41 AM ET)**, sitting on the overnight low 27,624.50 after a 28,109 high, and giving back part of Monday's +3.4% NDX surge to 27,907.63 [1]. The trigger is **October CPI: headline +0.4% m/m vs 0.3% expected, core +0.3% vs 0.2%** [2,3], landing right after **Gov. Waller said a December hike is likely and opened the door to a 50 bp move** [3]. Rates and the dollar confirm it: **10-year +7 bp to 4.94%**, **dollar index +0.4% to 102.01**, **VIX up to 20.6** [1,2]. Nasdaq is taking the hit (NQ −1.4% vs ES −0.8% and YM −0.2%), and the AI chip names that led Monday are weakest premarket (**AMD −2.5%, AVGO −2.0%, NVDA −1.9%, TSLA −1.8%**) [1]. The offset is **oil −3% (WTI $84.13)** and a Monday rally that may draw dip buyers. So **lean short below 27,700; flip long on a reclaim of ~27,870**.
evidence_cutoff: Tue Nov 10, 2026, ~8:51 AM ET (9:51 AM Atlantic). Futures ~8:41 AM ET and premarket stock prints ~8:51 AM ET (Yahoo, may be delayed).

bullets.label: Inflation surprise on both lines.
bullets.text: Headline 0.4% and core 0.3%, each 0.1 pt above consensus [2,3]. The report has no annual figures this month, so the market is trading the monthly beat.

bullets.label: Fed pushed hawkish just before.
bullets.text: Waller said a December hike is likely and a 50 bp move is possible; IBD says CPI likely seals the December hike [3,4].

bullets.label: Rates and dollar confirm.
bullets.text: 10-year +7 bp to 4.94%, dollar +0.4%, VIX up [1,2]. Long-duration tech is the most rate-sensitive, and NQ is falling roughly twice as hard as ES while the Dow is near flat [1].

bullets.label: Momentum is at the lows.
bullets.text: NQ is printing the overnight low after a 485-pt slide from the 28,109 high [1].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Oil −3% softens the inflation path, Monday's +3.4% NDX rally shows dip buyers are active, and NQ is already stretched ~485 pts off the overnight high into the open, so a flush-and-reverse is possible [1].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: Hot core plus a Fed governor discussing 50 bp reprices the whole hike path; AI chip leaders from Monday (AMD, AVGO, NVDA) are leading the drop [1,3].

bullets.label: Stronger SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ stays under 27,700 through the first 15 minutes and the 10-year holds above 4.95%. Targets 27,500, then ~27,335.

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ reclaims and holds ~27,870 (overnight midpoint). Target the Monday settle 28,014.

bullets.label: Go STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: NQ chops between 27,624 and 27,870 with yields flat on the day.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: More Fed commentary after CPI; Nvidia/Huang headlines; oil moves on Middle East news; Anthropic IPO pricing chatter [4,5].

sources.text: FXStreet, "US Consumer Price Index rises 0.4% MoM in October vs. 0.3% expected" (Nov 10, 8:36 AM ET): core 0.3% vs 0.2% est; no 12-month changes due to 2025 shutdown data gap; DXY +0.3% at 102.00; FedWatch ~80% December hike odds pre-release.

CNBC live updates (8:38 AM ET Nov 10): Nasdaq-100 futures −1.2%, S&P −0.5%, Dow flat; Waller says December hike likely and opens door to 50 bp; CPI 0.4% vs 0.3%, core 0.3% vs 0.2%; Monday Dow +2.2%, S&P +2.4%, Nasdaq Comp +2.7%.
Investor's Business Daily, "CPI Inflation Stays Hot, Sealing Fed Rate Hike After Hawkish Waller" (Nov 10): core overshoot likely ensures a 25 bp December hike and raises odds of more.
Yahoo Finance live (8:42 AM ET Nov 10): Nvidia still weighed by the board's investigation into CEO Jensen Huang; oil down >2%. IBD (8:14 AM ET): Anthropic set a price range for its IPO.
